sentences.en: The story was too pat and I got rather suspicious.
sentences.zh: 这个故事太完美了，我开始有些怀疑。

sentences.en: The boss won't pat me on the head for that.
sentences.zh: 老板不会因为我那个而拍拍我的头表扬我。

sentences.en: The boss won't pat us on the head for that.
sentences.zh: 老板不会因为我们那个而拍拍我们的头表扬我们。

senses.zh: （用手掌）轻拍；轻拍……以引起注意；轻拍……（使）成形
